title: 메탈 기어 솔리드

metal_gear_solid.lookNote: 무전기는 들지 않고 두 손을 비운다 — 한 손은 바닥을 짚고 다른 손은 세운 무릎 위에. 고개를 들어 위쪽의 거대한 병기를 노려본다(카메라를 보지 않는다). 뒤의 병기는 어둠 속 형체로만 — 원작 병기의 디자인을 닮지 않게.

prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character (title form); keep her.

GAME: «메탈 기어 솔리드» (Metal Gear Solid), 1998. Genre: stealth action game. Graphics era: early 3D.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "원작 인물(스네이크·메릴·울프 등)의 얼굴"; "메탈 기어 병기의 똑같은 디자인"; "로고·타이틀 글자"; "화면 위 레이더·HUD"; "읽히는 글자·숫자".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined costume and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (recognizable, as the game shows them): "귀에 대는 작은 무전기", "기지 구석의 골판지 상자", "눈 내리는 헬기 이착륙장", "기지 복도의 환풍구와 철제 사다리".

Quoted notes may be Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

GARMENT: keep her material family (tight matte sneaking-suit weave with ribbed panels and straps) and palette, but let the cut change as FORM says — this form must read as a clearly different outfit silhouette from the attached image.

FORM — ENDING (엔딩): "찢긴 잠입 슈트 위의 검은 전술 코트와 붉은 반다나". Battle role: attacker. Stage of play: the finished run — most dazzling or most serene.
GEAR in the game's own style: "작전 마지막 날풍 — 전술 코트와 반다나".
FORM NOTE: 무전기는 들지 않고 두 손을 비운다 — 한 손은 바닥을 짚고 다른 손은 세운 무릎 위에. 고개를 들어 위쪽의 거대한 병기를 노려본다(카메라를 보지 않는다). 뒤의 병기는 어둠 속 형체로만 — 원작 병기의 디자인을 닮지 않게.

SETTING (this form): "거대한 병기가 선 어두운 격납고 — 붉은 경보등" — the finale — wide, open composition with space around her, warm golden or afterglow light.

HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "눈보라가 걷히며 기지의 탐조등이 일제히 그녀를 지나간다"; "경보가 울리며 헬기장의 탐조등이 한곳으로 모인다"; "격납고의 거대한 그림자가 움직이려는 순간 불꽃이 튀며 멈춘다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "격납고 바닥에 한쪽 무릎을 대고 위를 노려보는 자세" — a grand final pose, seen from a slightly high, more distant camera, easy to read as a card.

OUTPUT: the ending form of the woman in the attached image, as a new card image. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone, body proportions and palette; change only her costume and bearing, as FORM says. Do not reuse its outer garment or lining artwork — build the costume FORM describes. Build the background, light and camera from SETTING and STANCE — do not reuse the attached image's background, floor, lighting or camera angle. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view).

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names. Her hands keep the same gloves or bare hands as in the attached image, unless FORM names gloves.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
